deviations.justification: pr-review-cycle is a named lint source; the frozen-snapshot isolation (git archive / throwaway worktree) is stated as intent with the capability name (worktree.create) instead of a literal command.
Isolated worktrees are named via worktree.create; no literal `git worktree` remains in the named source.
The parent's branch precondition is stated as intent; working-tree state is named via workflow.status.
The working-tree precondition is named via workflow.status (default `git status --porcelain`) without a literal command.
Tree-id resolution is stated as intent ("its tree id") because no workflow capability resolves tree ids.
